recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **All-purpose flour:** 240 g
- **Baking powder:** 7 g
- **Sea salt:** 5 mL
- **Butter:** 250 g (cold) ([**5:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=348s))
- **Granulated white sugar:** 100 g
- **Brown sugar:** 150 g
- **Fresh lemons:** 2 lemons (to get 44.5 mL of zest) ([**0:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=22s))
- **Whole milk:** 120 mL
- **Eggs:** 4 large eggs
- **Dark maple syrup:** 80 mL (the secret twist!) ([**8:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=510s))

**For the Quick Lemon Glaze:**

- **Powdered sugar:** 120 g ([**10:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=618s))
- **Whole milk:** 10 mL ([**10:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=631s))
- **Fresh lemon juice:** 15 mL ([**10:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=631s))
recipe-section-1.html:
• All-purpose flour: 240 g
  • Baking powder: 7 g
  • Sea salt: 5 mL
  • Butter: 250 g (cold) (5:48)
  • Granulated white sugar: 100 g
  • Brown sugar: 150 g
  • Fresh lemons: 2 lemons (to get 44.5 mL of zest) (0:22)
  • Whole milk: 120 mL
  • Eggs: 4 large eggs
  • Dark maple syrup: 80 mL (the secret twist!) (8:30)

For the Quick Lemon Glaze:

  • Powdered sugar: 120 g (10:18)
  • Whole milk: 10 mL (10:31)
  • Fresh lemon juice: 15 mL (10:31)
recipe-section-1.title: For the Cake Batter

recipe-section-3.markdown:
- Preheat your oven to 175 °C ([**8:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=488s)).
- Zest the outer yellow layer of 2 fresh lemons until you have 44.5 mL of zest ([**0:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=22s)).
- *Tip:* Use a microplane upside down to collect the zest on top ([**1:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=97s)), and avoid grating into the bitter white pith ([**0:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=33s)).
recipe-section-3.html:
• Preheat your oven to 175 °C (8:08).
  • Zest the outer yellow layer of 2 fresh lemons until you have 44.5 mL of zest (0:22).
  • Tip: Use a microplane upside down to collect the zest on top (1:37), and avoid grating into the bitter white pith (0:33).
recipe-section-3.title: Step 1: Prep and Zesting

recipe-section-4.markdown:
- Weigh 100 g of white granulated sugar and 150 g of brown sugar into a bowl ([**3:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=212s)).
- Add the lemon zest directly into the sugar mixture ([**2:02**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=122s)).
- Rub the zest and sugars thoroughly between your hands (or pulse in a food processor) until the texture resembles wet sand ([**2:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=131s)). This releases the essential oils from the zest for an explosive flavor ([**2:16**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=136s)).
recipe-section-4.html:
• Weigh 100 g of white granulated sugar and 150 g of brown sugar into a bowl (3:32).
  • Add the lemon zest directly into the sugar mixture (2:02).
  • Rub the zest and sugars thoroughly between your hands (or pulse in a food processor) until the texture resembles wet sand (2:11). This releases the essential oils from the zest for an explosive flavor (2:16).
recipe-section-4.title: Step 2: Make the Lemon Sugar

recipe-section-5.markdown:
- Add 250 g of cold butter into the lemon sugar and cream them together ([**5:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=332s)).
- Add 240 g of all-purpose flour, 7 g of baking powder, and 5 mL of sea salt ([**6:43**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=403s)).
- Pour in 120 mL of whole milk, crack in 4 large eggs, and add the special 80 mL twist of dark maple syrup ([**7:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=440s)).
- Mix everything until just combined, ensuring you scrape any remaining flour from the edges of the bowl ([**9:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=549s)).
recipe-section-5.html:
• Add 250 g of cold butter into the lemon sugar and cream them together (5:32).
  • Add 240 g of all-purpose flour, 7 g of baking powder, and 5 mL of sea salt (6:43).
  • Pour in 120 mL of whole milk, crack in 4 large eggs, and add the special 80 mL twist of dark maple syrup (7:20).
  • Mix everything until just combined, ensuring you scrape any remaining flour from the edges of the bowl (9:09).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 3: Reverse Creaming & Batter MixAdd

recipe-section-6.markdown:
- Generously spray a bundt pan (a silicone bundt mold helps prevent cracking) or a standard loaf pan ([**8:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=526s)).
- Pour the batter in and tap the pan against the counter to distribute it evenly ([**9:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=554s)).
- Bake at 175 °C for exactly 1 hour ([**8:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=488s)). Let it cool down after baking.
recipe-section-6.html:
• Generously spray a bundt pan (a silicone bundt mold helps prevent cracking) or a standard loaf pan (8:46).
  • Pour the batter in and tap the pan against the counter to distribute it evenly (9:14).
  • Bake at 175 °C for exactly 1 hour (8:08). Let it cool down after baking.
recipe-section-6.title: Step 4: Fill and Bake

recipe-section-7.markdown:
- In a small bowl, combine 120 g of powdered sugar, 10 mL of whole milk, and 15 mL of fresh lemon juice ([**10:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=618s)).
- Whisk with a fork or mini whisk until it forms a thick, smooth glaze ([**11:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgUVm9wVgRA&t=668s)).
- Drizzle the glaze over the top of the cooled pound cake, letting it run beautifully down the sides.
recipe-section-7.html:
• In a small bowl, combine 120 g of powdered sugar, 10 mL of whole milk, and 15 mL of fresh lemon juice (10:18).
  • Whisk with a fork or mini whisk until it forms a thick, smooth glaze (11:08).
  • Drizzle the glaze over the top of the cooled pound cake, letting it run beautifully down the sides.
recipe-section-7.title: Step 5: Glaze and Assemble
